concerns.text: Consumer-before-producer: T003 merges into `data/dataset.csv` and T004 validates it against `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml`, but that schema REQUIRES `fingerprint_vector`, which is only produced in T005. T003's own verification ('all schema-required columns present and finite') is unachievable at its position in the order. Either move full-schema validation after T005, validate a reduced column set in T004, or have T005 write the schema-conformant file and add a post-T005 validation step.

T002 reads `data/dataset_with_metrics.csv`, but no task produces it. T001 writes only `data/raw_cif/` and `data/source_verification.json`; the step that parses CIFs into SMILES + pc_raw + unit_cell_volume rows (FR-002/FR-003 computation) has no producer task. Add a task between T001 and T002 that emits `dataset_with_metrics.csv` (SMILES extraction/generation, PC computation from Bondi volumes), or fold it into T001's parse step explicitly.

T005 writes `data/processed/full_feature_matrix.csv` while T003/T004 operate on `data/dataset.csv`; the data-model says dataset.schema.yaml validates `full_feature_matrix.csv`. Two near-duplicate dataset artifacts with unclear which downstream tasks (T006 trains on 'SMILES fingerprints') consume. Clarify the artifact chain: one file, or state explicitly that T006 reads full_feature_matrix.csv.

T009 'merges' sensitivity/bonferroni blocks into `data/artifacts/validation_report.json` created in T007/T008 — order is correct, but the schema requires `bonferroni_correction` and `sensitivity_analysis` at top level, so the report written by T007 cannot validate until T009 runs. Note this explicitly (or write the report once, after T009) so T007's 'report JSON validates' verification is not false at its stage.
